description: This file defines the BuzzLink entity class for the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin, representing links associated with Buzz posts in the database via Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: BuzzLink
classes.description: Entity class representing a link associated with a Buzz post, including properties for id, post, link, originalLink, and their respective getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the BuzzLink entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the BuzzLink entity.

methods.name: getPost
methods.description: Retrieves the BuzzPost associated with this link.

methods.name: setPost
methods.description: Associates a BuzzPost entity with this link.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns the URL/link stored in this BuzzLink entity.

methods.name: setLink
methods.description: Sets the URL/link in this BuzzLink entity.

methods.name: setOriginalLink
methods.description: Sets the original URL link, potentially different from the stored link.
